# Nimble | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Client development for consultants | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, to verify whether consultant customer breeding actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Social marketing | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the disc, to verify whether social sales actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Small B2B pipe | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage a double disk, to verify whether the small B2B pipeline really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Follow-up and community development | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether post-action follow-up and group movements actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
